stem.text: Forces are applied to a rigid body. The forces all act in the same plane.
In which diagram is the body in equilibrium?

A.alt: Grey rectangular block with vertical force arrows labelled ½F and F.

B.alt: Grey rectangular block with vertical force arrows labelled F.

C.alt: Grey rectangular block with vertical force arrows labelled F.

D.alt: Grey rectangular block with vertical force arrows labelled ½F.
